description: This file defines a class `VoiceWakeTester` that manages voice recognition for wake word detection using Apple's Speech and AVFoundation frameworks. It handles starting and stopping voice recognition sessions, processing recognition results, managing permissions, and debugging.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTestState
classes.description: An enumeration representing different states of the voice wake testing process, such as idle, requesting, listening, hearing, finalizing, detected, and failed.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: A class that manages voice recognition sessions for wake word detection, handling permissions, audio engine configuration, recognition task management, and result processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the VoiceWakeTester with a specified locale.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the voice recognition session with given triggers and configurations, setting up audio engine and recognition task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current recognition session immediately.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends the recognition with a timeout, releasing resources once recognition completes or times out.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes recognition results, updates state, triggers detections, and manages lifecycle accordingly.

methods.name: maybeLogDebug
methods.description: Logs debug information about the recognition process, transcripts, and segments.

methods.name: debugSegments
methods.description: Converts segments into a formatted string for debugging.

methods.name: debugCandidateGaps
methods.description: Calculates and formats gaps between trigger segments and detected tokens for debugging.

methods.name: holdUntilSilence
methods.description: Maintains hold state until silence is detected or timeout occurs, then stops recognition.

methods.name: scheduleSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a task to check for silence and trigger detection if detected.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures audio input session, placeholder implementation.

methods.name: logInputSelection
methods.description: Logs information about selected audio input device.

methods.name: ensurePermissions
methods.description: Checks and requests microphone and speech recognition permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: hasPrivacyStrings
methods.description: Checks if the app's Info.plist contains necessary privacy usage description strings.
